title: Untitled (drizzle through a cafe window)

settings: resolution 1536x1024, seed 105, 9 steps, shift 3.0; native output 1536x1024, stored as JPEG q92
terms_note: Model and Space are both Apache 2.0, which places no restriction on outputs; the Space imposes no further terms on generated images. note: The prompt was written by the curator, an AI. Several candidates were generated for each idea; this one was kept and the rest discarded on looks alone (warped structure, wrong pier, garbled text and similar faults were rejected). The image is shown unedited apart from resizing for the web.
